title: Annotatio I §.I Acerbitas: That dissent erupted into the foul beginning of the Protestant schism
pass_a_gloss: partly of acerbitas — because this dissent at last erupted into the nerve, so that it gave a foul beginning to the Protestant schism.
pass_b_english: They are prior partly by acerbitas.
That dissent at last erupted into the nerve and gave a foul beginning to the Protestant schism.
source_text: partim acerbitatis, quòd dissensus hic in nervum tandem erupit, ut schismati Protestantico turpe dederit initium.

choices.english: erupted into the nerve / came to a head
